review_description: Very proactive in quoting but once you pay the service levels start declining.Was promised a $200 refund for extended delays (install date changed without informing us) and issues but that never came. Was unable to contact them. Even after sales customer service is impossible as all the contact avenues led nowhere.Seems like that kind of industry?

Initially contact was good, email calls etc.  deposit paid and approximate install date negotiated.  Due to renovations on my house we delayed the install for a period of time, all agreed this was okay.  I have tried to contact them now for almost 18 months without success, even sought support from Fair trading who also had no success with communication.  They have taken my money and disappeared.
Don't deal with these people, never answer phone, never give back up service never cover their warranties.
2 years on and still not connected to the grid - they donâ€™t answer the phone or return calls.  Unbelievable!!!
Additional cost involved as the installers damaged our TV antenna.

The principal, Sam is not very good at keeping his word with regards to refund of money or even to return calls to direct my query about where to take warranty claims. Solar panels seemed to have stopped working!

Jesse came and inspected the house and installation was booked in.  The installers then refused to install the panels.  After refusing to take calls and answer emails,  they offered a refund of my deposit.  Now they are not taking calls again and Iâ€™m still chasing my deposit.  Shocking customer service.

Unfortunately, I encountered one of the retailers that gives the industry a bad name.I had agreed upon a 12kW system. Come the installation day, without any prior notice, the installers appeared with the wrong colour panels and the wrong size inverter.I did not allow the installation to proceed.Nothing was said about the agreed sized Fronius inverter not being available, despite the considerable period of time between the deposit being paid (contract date) and the installation date .Afterwards, I was offered all sorts of "bait and switch" options: lowered powered REC panels, different brand panels, and an inferior Huawei inverter as the Fronius inverter agreed upon was not available anytime soon.  I said I was not interested in these, but what was agreed upon.  As there was no serious intention to secure the agreed inverter and panels, despite me having to follow up repeatedly, I requested to cancel the system and requested a refund on my deposit.  However, the manager/owner claims he doesn't legally have to refund my deposit.  Still waiting on the return of my deposit.This is a salient warning to others to avoid this unscrupulous operator.
